cases.subject: Call.muteAudio() in telnyx/webrtc 2.25.25 not muting outbound RTCRtpSender on supervisor leg
cases.summary: WebRTC SDK muteAudio() fails on supervisor (whisper) leg — mute takes effect briefly then outbound RTP resumes at ~13kbps Opus despite isMuted staying true.

analysis.method: Merged B2BUA SIPcap + Ringba-side PCAP analysis
keyFindings: muteAudio() does NOT mute outbound RTCRtpSender — payload is real audio, not Opus-encoded silence
5s before mute: 250 pkts, avg 36.0 bytes, 99% speech
5s after mute: 250 pkts, avg 54.6 bytes, 98% speech — ZERO difference from pre-mute
Known-silent window for comparison: avg 8.0 bytes, 0% speech
B2BUA leg shows only 160-byte comfort noise (not real speech)
Call topology: Ringba↔Verto direct media (g711U), Supervisor browser↔Verto WebRTC (Opus/encrypted)
analysis.rootCauseHypothesis: ICE renegotiation (701 errors) causes SDK to re-attach/replace sender track, losing enabled=false state
analysis.escalationStatus: Follow-up escalation drafted with PCAP evidence, Sean reviewing to send
